description: PQZL proofs of the split transfer (spec three-key model K3-4, R_TXS / R_TXS0; UNAUDITED) under PQZL_SPLIT_ID (set.json pqzl_split_label), from the core (hedged, CTR-PQZ-19), fixed rnd32: deterministic. base: the scenario's TRANSFER / TRANSFER0 row, whose header (bytes 32..63 = PQZL_SPLIT_ID), pk_f, pk_t, [pk_a] and T the statement keeps; out = u || v_t || v_f || [v_a] || u_f: the leg's u, v_t, v_a = Enc([pk_t, pk_a], [value, value], seed_leg), seed_leg = SHAKE256(SCAAS-PQZ-ENC-LEG-V1 || seed_enc || be4(0) || toUA || keccak256(pk_t))[0..32) (objects.leg.seed_enc), the sender's u_f, v_f = Enc([pk_f], [new balance], seed_enc) (objects.own). wit (pqz.h PQZ_TXS_WIT_BYTES; R3): s_f || e_f || r || e1 || r_f || e1_f || e2_t || e2_f || [e2_a] || d || d'. Validity: pqz-vectors (specialised and generic verifier); the precompile serves PQZL_ID only.
